We studied the ALD-deposited Al 2O3 layers by X-ray diffraction (XRD). However, within the sensitivity of our system, all u–2u scans indicated an entirely amorphous structure, with no sign of crystalline phases in our Al 2O3 films (not shown here).

We conducted high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) on our Al 2O3 and Al 2O3/ZrO2 nanolaminate layers in order to study the morphology of the films on the nanometer scale.
